categories.hint: VP of the highest threshold reached on the Reputation Track.

categories.label: Developments
categories.hint: VP of the rightmost empty column in the Development area.

categories.label: Leftover supplies
categories.hint: Resources, money, ads, agenda cards and blueprints: 1 VP per 3.

categories.label: Progress cubes on track (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Total your Progress Cubes on the Progress Track.

categories.hint: Tự lấy từ tổng Cockpit, không nhập lần hai.

tiebreakers.description: Most Progress Cubes on the Progress Track
Later in turn order wins after all previous tiebreakers.

notes: Multiplayer base scoring. Cockpits is the signed net total after subtracting 5 per unlaunched shuttle; cockpitVp derives from it. Supply quantities combine at 1 VP per 3. Complete final shuttle advancement before entering pre-AGM-C track VP. Retail printing still needs comparison with the accessible publisher-authored training manual; Rachel solo and expansion modules are not automated.
